name: WG Responsive Slider
author: abdulbaquee

sections.description:
Overview

WG Responsive Slider is built using WordPress best practices for both frontend and backend development. This results in an efficient, robust, and intuitive plugin that works with any theme, including WordPress Default Themes. The plugin is fully customizable and suitable for both technical and non-technical users.

Usage

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Go to “Manage Sliders” under WG Slider
  3. Click “Add New Slider”
  4. Add slides with titles, images, and content
  5. Copy the shortcode and place it in a post, page, or template
  6. Done!
sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 5.5 or greater
  • PHP version 7.4 or greater
  • MySQL version 5.6 or greater

Features

• The most SEO-friendly slider plugin in the market!
• Easy-to-use interface
• Create fully responsive and device-optimized sliders
• Cross-browser compatibility – works well on all popular browsers
• Lightweight output compared to other plugins
• HTML5-valid and clean markup
• Touch swipe navigation
• Manage slideshows with various options:
– Caption show/hide
– Caption alignment
– Slides per page
– Autoplay
– Navigation
– Bullets
– Multiple effects
– Loop functionality
• 24/7 expert support
• User-friendly admin panel
• CSS3 transitions with jQuery fallback
• Hardware-accelerated CSS3 3D transforms
• Optimized for all screen sizes and touch devices
• Smart asset loading
• Mouse wheel navigation
• Customizable arrows
• Exclusive shortcodes & custom functions for template files
• Scroll handle slide indicator
• Admin-only slider management
• Built-in cache boosting
• Multi-site compatible

Compatible Browsers

  • Chrome
  • Firefox
  • Opera
  • Edge
  • Safari
  • IE11
  • iPad, iPhone
  • Android devices

Documentation

If you have any questions about working with “WG Responsive Slider”, you can reach us on Twitter WG

Automatic Installation (Recommended)

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard
  2. Navigate to the Plugins menu
  3. Click “Add New”
  4. Search for “WG Responsive Slider”
  5. Click “Install Now”

Manual Installation

Via WordPress Dashboard

  1. Download wg-responsive-slider.zip
  2. Navigate to “Add New” in the Plugins dashboard
  3. Click the “Upload” button
  4. Select wg-responsive-slider.zip
  5. Click “Install Now”
  6. Activate the plugin

Via FTP

  1. Download wg-responsive-slider.zip
  2. Extract the folder
  3. Upload it to /wp-content/plugins/
  4. Activate the plugin

For more details, see the WordPress Codex.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin free?

Yes, it is 100% free.

Is it compatible with the latest WordPress and PHP versions?

Yes, it is fully compatible with WordPress 6.8 and PHP 7.4 to 8.3.

Does it work with all modern browsers?

Yes, it is tested across all major desktop and mobile browsers.
